original.statement: The Helm value tls.secretsBackend (local or k8s) is deprecated and replaced by tls.readSecretsOnlyFromSecretsNamespace as part of TLS Visibility moving to SDS.

decision.reason: [ev-ed86f8eb85bf] says the Helm value `tls.secretsBackend` has been deprecated and replaced with `tls.readSecretsOnlyFromSecretsNamespace`. The environments exposed are those that still set the deprecated key and have not set its replacement. Environments that already set `tls.readSecretsOnlyFromSecretsNamespace` explicitly are covered by the replacement, so they belong in the overlap. This matches the standard shape for a deprecated Helm value that has a replacement, and both validators confirm that `tls.secretsBackend` exists in both releases [ev-28e0ccb5774a] [ev-39a22d88e2f5].
